strategies.reason: Same SMA5 recovery and common news-evidence check, rejecting entries with a selected provider-linked company article published within the frozen 120-hour window. Research only; no original-delivery or classifier-accuracy claim.
Same entry and exit rules as 6.0.0; plans from the prior close and keeps trades that open beyond the stop instead of deleting them with a future price.

Approved 8 November 2026: Connors and Alvarez (2008) RSI(2) rules as published (close > SMA200, RSI(2) < 5, exit on close > SMA5) with no market filter, stop, target or time limit; next-open fill is the one named difference, and the fill day's close is the first exit check (replaces never-run 8.0.0); sized by position notional. Research only.

Approved 8 November 2026: short-term reversal after a news-free drop (Jegadeesh 1990, Lehmann 1990, Chan 2003) using the saved snapback screen's stretch: RSI(14) < 30 and close at least 10% below SMA20, no 200-day filter, recent company news vetoed; exit on close > SMA5 or after 5 bars, the fill day's close being the first check and bar 1 (replaces never-run 1.0.0); sized by position notional. Operational version, not a replication. Research only.

Approved 8 November 2026: short side of the Connors and Alvarez (2008) RSI(2) rules as published (close < SMA200, RSI(2) > 95, cover on close < SMA5, first checked on the fill day's close; replaces never-run 1.0.0) with no market filter, stop, target or time limit; next-open fill is the one named difference; sized by position notional. A short with no stop has unbounded loss; research only.

Approved 8 November 2026: mirror of swing.snapback for a news-free rise (Jegadeesh 1990, Lehmann 1990, Chan 2003): RSI(14) >= 70 and close at least 10% above SMA20, no 200-day filter, recent company news vetoed; cover on close < SMA5 or after 5 bars; the fill day's close is the first check and bar 1 (replaces never-run 1.0.0); sized by position notional. Operational version, not a replication. A short with no stop has unbounded loss; research only.

Approved 11 November 2026 (Connors whole-market design): the 9.0.0 trading rules unchanged, accepting as-traded (unadjusted) Alpaca SIP daily bars so it can run on whole-market research screens that leave out stock-days with a split in the 200-session look-back. Same-day candidates are taken lowest RSI(2) first, ties by symbol. Research only.

Approved 11 November 2026 (Connors whole-market design): the 7.0.0 trading rules unchanged (2xATR stop, 2.5R target, 5-bar limit, S&P 500 trend filter), accepting as-traded (unadjusted) Alpaca SIP daily bars for whole-market research screens that leave out stock-days with a split in the 200-session look-back. Comparison for 9.1.0. Research only.

Approved 11 November 2026 (Connors whole-market design): the 2.0.0 short trading rules unchanged, accepting as-traded (unadjusted) Alpaca SIP daily bars for whole-market research screens that leave out stock-days with a split in the 200-session look-back. Same-day candidates are taken most stretched first (highest RSI(2)), ties by symbol. A short with no stop has unbounded loss; borrow is not modelled; research only.

Approved 12 November 2026 (Connors one-year hourly-entry amendment): the 9.1.0 trading rules unchanged, bound to the decision-hour timing policy: the daily rules are evaluated on the 15:00 New York hourly close standing in for the day's close and entries and exits fill in the 15:00-16:00 hour, on as-traded bars. Research only; the engine refuses this timing until it is implemented.
